_comment: Every texture of samples/aetherbound: the image files the game draws (sky cards, UI art), its colour grades (.cube) and every image embedded in its models (addressed model.glb#image), each with the profile it is judged by, the flaws it is allowed to keep (a reason and a cap, so they cannot grow) and its visual review. Sprite sheets (the images an .anim.json names) belong to spritekit. `python3 tools/texturekit/validate.py --manifest tools/aetherbound/textures.json --engine build/fengine_headless` must pass; see tools/texturekit/README.md. A waiver that starts 'Known debt' is a flaw to remove the next time its generator is touched: fix it, then delete the waiver.

file.bloat.reason: Known debt from before texturekit: stored as a 24-bit PNG of 92 KB where a palette PNG of exactly the same pixels takes 46 KB. Fix in tools/aetherbound/chamber/paint.py save(): write the image with texturekit's tools.save_png before Blender loads it (the exporter keeps a file's bytes).

review.by: Claude (AI agent), from the review sheet
review.notes: Judged as a set (group sheet, each sheet, and an engine shot of the dais). floor is one 512 medallion: concentric slabs in slate blue and warm grey, bronze conduits, a ring of gold studs, clean hard pixels, 43 colours; floor_e draws only the conduit lines in aetherite violet with a white core (its brightness varies along the lines: a glow's falloff, not blur). metal and stone are trim sheets that wrap along U with no visible column: verdigris and bronze plating with gold rivets and a cut-out railing (alpha 0 or 255), and courses of indigo-grey masonry; metal_e lights the aetherite windows and the furnace band. Palette and values match SPEC.md (old metal, stone in shadow, fire, aetherite). The three normal maps are crisp and match their colour maps, but they are authored green-up and the engine, deriving tangents for this model, lights them upside down: on the sheet's lit views the bevels catch light on their lower edges. Accepted as the waived debt ready.normal_green (subtle under the chamber's many low lights; to fix in the generator or the engine), with floor's oversized PNG encoding.

review.by: Claude (AI agent), from the review sheets
review.notes: Re-read after the engine's derived tangents were corrected to glTF's green-up, which is how these six were authored: in the lit views of all six sheets the floor rings and bricks, the wall courses and rock, and the metal panels, rivets and trim now stand out as relief from both light directions. Pixels unchanged; the waiver for inverted lighting is gone.
